  - [Layer 1] Dev tools grow bottoms-up via a free tier that lets engineers evaluate core value; pricing must be transparent and forecastable (getmonetizely, maximize.partners).

  - [Layer 3] Price is one of several adoption barriers (onboarding time, docs, missing integrations, trust). Cutting price without knowing which barrier binds can raise signups while activation and revenue stay flat or drop.

- Real problem (stated): developer adoption is too low. Unknown: how low, measured how, compared to what.

  ✅ Zero new research work, keeps the plan exactly as the team agreed it
  ❌ Bets margin and pricing trust on an admitted guess, judged by a vanity metric

  ✅ Measures price sensitivity directly with a holdout and real conversion data
  ✅ Limits damage to the paid base, since only an experiment arm sees the price
  ❌ Needs experiment infra and traffic; 3-6 weeks and may be underpowered
